mapper.select: SELECT a.loan_acceleration_id, a.applied_base_rate, a.applied_additional_rate, a.carried_interest, a.paid_carried_interest, a.carried_overdue_principal, a.paid_carried_overdue_principal, la.loan_principal_balance FROM loan_acceleration a JOIN loan_account la ON la.loan_account_id = a.loan_account_id WHERE a.loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM acceleration_daily_charge WHERE loan_acceleration_id = #{loanAccelerationId} AND charge_date = #{chargeDate})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO acceleration_daily_charge (loan_acceleration_id, charge_date, loan_judgment_status_id, delinquency_target_amount, delinquency_rate, delinquency_charge, interest_amount, delinquency_status_id) VALUES (#{loanAccelerationId}, #{chargeDate}, #{loanJudgmentStatusId}, #{delinquencyTargetAmount}, #{delinquencyRate}, #{delinquencyCharge}, #{interestAmount}, #{delinquencyStatusId})
